# 三寶萬靈法懺

- DZJY  三寶萬靈法懺

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

*Repentance-Method to the Three Treasures and the Myriad Numina*

reviewed (閱) by **下元道士王守上** (the *Xiàyuán* Daoist priest Wáng Shǒushàng)

A three-juàn liturgical repentance text, an item from the *Chàn fǎ dà guān* family ([KR5i0076](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5i/KR5i0076)) extracted for separate printing. The text addresses the **Three Treasures** (三寶 = the *Sānqīng* / Three Pure Ones — Yùqīng, Shàngqīng, Tàiqīng — and their respective heavenly-worthy retinues) and the **Myriad Numina** (萬靈 = the universal Daoist pantheon down to the local deities). The format is the standard Daoist *kēyí* (ritual sequence): purification, *jìng kǒu* (mouth-purifying), *kāi chàn xiāng wén* (incense-text for opening the repentance), *bǎo gào* (treasure proclamations), the chants proper, *sān bǎo gào* (proclamation to the Three Treasures), and the closing dispatch.

**Abstract**

A standard Daoist liturgical *fǎ chàn* (repentance liturgy), reviewed for the 1809 DZJY by *Wáng Shǒushàng* under his title *Xiàyuán dàoshì* — the *Xiàyuán* (15th of 10th lunar month) being one of the three *Yuán* festivals. Composition of the text is c. 1700–1809; reception in the DZJY signals its acceptance into the planchette-circle's standard liturgical repertoire. The text is liturgically continuous with the [KR5i0076](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5i/KR5i0076) *Chàn fǎ dà guān* tradition.
